# Membrane WebRTC plugin v0.26.6 - Table of Contents

> Membrane WebRTC plugin

## Pages

- [Membrane WebRTC Plugin](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [Membrane.WebRTC.Live.Capture](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.Live.Capture.md): LiveView for capturing audio and video from a browser and sending it via WebRTC to `Membrane.WebRTC.Source`.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.Live.Player](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.Live.Player.md): LiveView for playing audio and video received via WebRTC from `Membrane.WebRTC.Sink`.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.PhoenixSignaling](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.PhoenixSignaling.md): Provides signaling capabilities for WebRTC connections through Phoenix channels.

- [Membrane.WebRTC.PhoenixSignaling.Socket](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.PhoenixSignaling.Socket.md): Phoenix Socket implementation which redirects all topics to a
Phoenix Channel capable of processing WebRTC signaling messages.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.Signaling](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.Signaling.md): Signaling channel for sending WebRTC signaling messages between Membrane elements
and other WebRTC peers.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.SignalingChannel](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.SignalingChannel.md): Deprecated since v0.24.0. Use Membrane.WebRTC.Signaling instead.

- [Membrane.WebRTC.SimpleWebSocketServer](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.SimpleWebSocketServer.md): A simple WebSocket server spawned by `Membrane.WebRTC.Source`
and `Membrane.WebRTC.Sink`. It accepts a single connection
and passes the messages between the client and a Membrane
element.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.Sink](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.Sink.md): Membrane Bin that allows sending audio and video tracks via WebRTC.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.Source](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.Source.md): Membrane Bin that allows receiving audio and video tracks via WebRTC.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.WhipClient](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.WhipClient.md): WebRTC WHIP Client.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.WhipServer](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.WhipServer.md): Server accepting WHIP connections.
- [Membrane.WebRTC.WhipServer.Router](https://membrane-webrtc-plugin.hexdocs.pm/Membrane.WebRTC.WhipServer.Router.md): WHIP router pluggable to a plug pipeline.
